hypothesis: lambda_margin=1.0 (SF7) moved the first-answer-token decision far more than needed and caused D3 retention hard-stops in 2/3 seeds. A smaller lambda_margin may preserve enough pairwise separation to make factual acquisition reliable while keeping D3 comfortably below its ceiling. This is a dose question only; the mechanism itself is already established by SF7 and is not retested here.
manipulated_variable: lambda_margin only: control=0.0 (no hinge term), low=0.25, medium=0.50. M is fixed at 1.0 nat in both treatment arms, identical to SF7. No LR schedule change. No data change. No scope change.

control.note: no hinge term computed or added; byte-identical objective to SF6/SF7 control

pairing: Same intended seed within each triplet; independent fresh processes/parent/optimizer from untouched Pilot1 for all nine runs. Bitwise trajectory equality NOT required. Numerical variation before dose divergence does not invalidate a run unless a frozen integrity rule is violated. All nine runs declared and sealed before any endpoint result is observed. No seed replacement for unfavorable outcome. No rescue. No dose tuning or interim winner selection. No tenth run.
schedule: Unchanged SCHEDULE.json (byte-identical copy verified against sealed SF7): 200 updates = 180 English + 20 binding; bindings at 10,20,...,200. Every English batch is all 16 TRAIN records twice, literal ordering. English LR is the single constant 5e-5 in ALL THREE arms for every update. NO LR ANNEALING.
english_objective_control: Unchanged SF2/SF6/SF7 control objective: full-vocabulary causal CE over four response tokens+EOS, mean supervised tokens; plus lambda=1.0 D_KL(student||Pilot1) over 160 frozen positions. No hinge term is computed for control arms at all.
english_objective_treatment: Control-arm objective PLUS: for each of the 32 factual sequences/update, gap = logp_correct_name_token - logp_wrong_name_token at the first answer-token position (full-vocabulary log-softmax of the same forward-pass logits already used for CE). hinge = max(0, 1.0 - gap). margin_loss = mean(hinge) over the 32 sequences. Total English loss = factual_CE + parent_KL + lambda_margin * margin_loss, with lambda_margin=0.25 (low) or 0.50 (medium). Identical hinge formula/position/symmetry to SF7; only the weight differs. Hinge acts ONLY at the first answer name-token position; never full-string score, never EOS, never any other position or objective.
kl_data: Unchanged KL_POOL.json (165363 positions/741 rows), 160 selected per English index 1..180, frozen rotation. Identical in all three arms.
binding: Unchanged pinned answer causal CE + 1.0536573711078283 hard-min localization. Identical rehearsal identities/order/LR in all three arms.
scope: Unchanged PINNED_MASKING.set_scope: English = all base_model params except blocks0-3; binding = all params. Identical in all three arms.
evaluation: Unchanged pinned SF2 panel/score/checks/measure_d3. No new evaluation code. The margin/gap is recorded descriptively post-hoc from the already-frozen per-item token_scores_including_eos; it is never computed by, or fed into, the gating logic.

gates.acquisition_guard100: STOP arm if correct<10 AND exact<10

margin_is_not_a_gate: The first-answer-token gap/margin is recorded ONLY as descriptive mechanism evidence at 100/200. It is never a pass/fail criterion.
stopping: No endpoint selection. Each run stops at 200 or its frozen 100/200 guard/regression stop. Other preregistered runs continue after any individual arm's failure or hard stop. Integrity/provenance/nonfinite/runtime failure halts study for mechanical resolution or report. No rescue, no extra runs, no dose changes after launch.
transfer: All HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING remain LOCKED_UNSCORED. FINAL/sacred never accessed.
primary_comparison: Per-dose raw full-gate success count /3, D3-hard-stop count /3, other-retention-failure count /3, endpoint-availability count /3. All nine runs fixed before outcomes.
secondary_comparison: Per-item first-answer-token gap at 100/200 for all 16 items per run, derived descriptively from token_scores_including_eos. Report wooden-boat/Alex gap, min/mean g0:a0, mean g0:a1, mean g1, alongside D3, for every run at 100 and 200.
numerical_uncertainty: N=3 same-seed triplets cannot establish statistical certainty or generalization. A single favorable run at a dose is not proof of reliability at that dose.

study_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP: takes priority if any arm stops before 200 in a way that prevents comparison of all nine intended endpoints for the primary dose comparison
study_interpretation.TREATMENT_FAILED_RETENTION: takes priority if a dose's arms fail retention (D3/language/binding) more often than they achieve full-gate success
study_interpretation.LOW_DOSE_FAVORED: lambda=0.25 achieves more full-gate successes than control and than lambda=0.50, with comfortable D3 and no more retention failures than control
study_interpretation.MEDIUM_DOSE_FAVORED: lambda=0.50 achieves more full-gate successes than control and than lambda=0.25, with comfortable D3 and no more retention failures than control
study_interpretation.BOTH_DOSES_SUPPORTED: both 0.25 and 0.50 achieve full-gate success with comfortable D3 and no excess retention failures; prefer the smaller adequate dose per protocol philosophy, do not treat larger margin as inherently better
study_interpretation.CONTROL_FAVORED: no treatment dose improves on control's success rate
study_interpretation.MIXED: doses disagree in direction across seeds with no consistent favorite
study_interpretation.NO_CLEAR_DIFFERENCE: all arms (control and both doses) succeed or fail at statistically indistinguishable low N
study_interpretation.statistical_limit: No population p-value/CI; raw N=3 seeds per dose only.

history: SF1 STOP_REGRESSION, SF2 ACQUISITION_FAIL, SF3/SF4 hard stops, SF5 failed prefork, SF6 CONTROL_FAVORED_OR_MIXED, SF7 INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP (mechanism established: lambda=1.0 drives g0:a0 gaps strongly positive but trips D3 in 2/3 seeds; 1/3 treatment endpoints achieved full ACQUISITION_SUCCESS) remain unchanged and unmodified. SF8 tests only the dose question raised by SF7; no new mechanism search.
